name: Basket Buddy
greeting: Hi, I'm Basket Buddy! Ask me about markets, opening times or produce.
quick: How do I save a market?
fallback: Sorry, I only know about FreshFind markets and produce. Try asking about opening times, seasons, nearby markets or bookmarks.

faq.a: Every market has its own weekly schedule. Filter the directory by day, or look for the Open now badge.
Markets open right now show an Open now badge on the home page and in the directory.
Use the Day filter in the directory and choose Sat or Sun to see weekend markets.
Pick the day in the Day filter of the Market Directory to see which markets are open.
Press Use my location, then sort the directory by Nearest.
FreshFind only uses your location to sort by distance. If you say no, the list simply falls back to A to Z.
We list markets in Umuahia, Aba, Port Harcourt, Owerri, Enugu, Awka, Uyo and Calabar. Use the Area filter to narrow down.
The home page shows seasonal picks, and every Produce Guide card shows its season.
The Produce Guide filters by category: Tubers, Vegetables, Fruits, Herbs, Dairy & Eggs, and Grains & Legumes.
Open any card in the Produce Guide to see which markets usually stock that item.
Press Save on any market or produce card. Your list is on the Bookmarks page.
You can add a personal note to anything you save. Notes last for this visit only.
On the Bookmarks page press Export as list, then Copy list to paste it into a message.
Every market page has share links for WhatsApp, X and Facebook.
Each market page shows the full address and an embedded map.
Our contact details and a live map are on the Contact Us page.
Login and Sign up are design placeholders for now, so you don't need an account to use FreshFind.
FreshFind was built by our Techwiz team to make local farmers markets easier to find.
FreshFind is free to use. Prices are set by each market's sellers, so ask at the stall.
Choose firm tomatoes with smooth skin, leafy greens with no yellowing, and a pineapple that smells sweet at the base.
Wrap leafy greens in a damp cloth in the fridge, keep tomatoes and yams cool and dry, and refrigerate milk and eggs.
I can help you find markets, check opening days, explore produce by season and use your bookmarks.

Goodbye! Enjoy your fresh finds.
